newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Sept nickel exports rise to 14,170 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Russian Sept nickel exports rise to 14,170 tonnes.

text.p: Russian exports of nickel and nickel alloys in September were 14,170 tonnes, the State Customs Committee said on Friday.
The committee said that the figures, quoted by Interfax news agency, represented a 6.5 percent increase on August levels.
Russia's imports of nickel ores and concentrates, from Kazakhstan and Finland, increased nearly two-fold on the previous month's level, but Interfax gave no absolute figures.
Total nickel exports over January-September rose 6.3 percent year-on-year and were 117,364 tonnes.
But total nickel output in September was flat on August's levels, while output over January-July was four percent below year-ago levels.
